notes: ResDepth (Stucker & Schindler 2022) as published, with the lasground_new DTM as the initial raster (channel 0) and LiDAR rasters as guidance: per-tile mean centring + global std, L1 in metres, Adam 2e-4, batch 20, StepLR. ResDepth trains 20000 samples per epoch with the LR divided by 10 every 200 epochs; here step_size is in iterations (200 epochs x 1000 iterations).
